defs.private.assert_initialized():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.assert_initialized()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$

defs.public.admin_online_status():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_online_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare editors text[]:=array['public.m1_check_editor()','public.m1_editor_articles()','public.m1_get_draft(uuid)','public.m1_operation_status(uuid,text)',
  'public.m1_create_draft(uuid)','public.m1_save_draft(uuid,bigint,jsonb)','public.catalog_save_draft(uuid,bigint,jsonb,bigint)','public.m1_preview_draft(uuid,bigint,bigint,bigint)',
  'public.m1_publish_draft(uuid,bigint,bigint,bigint,bigint,text)','public.m1_set_state(uuid,bigint,text,text)','public.catalog_editor_sectors()','public.catalog_editor_index(integer,integer)',
  'public.catalog_editor_tree(bigint)','public.catalog_editor_sector(uuid,bigint,integer,integer)','public.catalog_editor_companies(integer,integer,text)','public.catalog_editor_company(uuid,bigint)',
  'public.catalog_editor_group(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_editor_membership(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_editor_impact(uuid,bigint)','public.catalog_apply(bigint,text,text,uuid,jsonb)',
  'public.catalog_operation_status(bigint,text,text,uuid,jsonb)'];
  sessions text[]:=array['public.m1_open_admin_session(uuid,uuid,text,text,timestamptz)','public.m1_read_admin_session(text)','public.m1_close_admin_session(text)'];
begin
  perform private.assert_server();
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'editorGrants',(select count(*) from unnest(editors) f where has_function_privilege('authenticated',f,'EXECUTE')),
    'sessionGrants',(select count(*) from unnest(sessions) f where has_function_privilege('service_role',f,'EXECUTE')),
    'activeMemberships',(select count(*) from private.admin_memberships where active),
    'openSessions',(select count(*) from private.admin_sessions where revoked_at is null and expires_at>now()),
    'adminAuthSessions',(select count(*) from auth.sessions s join private.admin_memberships m on m.user_id=s.user_id));
end$function$
defs.public.maintenance_admin_status():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintenance_admin_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare jobs jsonb;runs jsonb;at_time timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
begin
 perform private.m1_assert_editor();
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',j.kind,'registered',c.jobid is not null,'active',c.active,
 'schedule',c.schedule,'job_id',j.job_id,'state',private.maintenance_job_state(c.jobid is not null,c.active,d.runid is not null,d.status,d.start_time,j.created_at,j.kind,at_time),
 'last_started_at',d.start_time,'last_finished_at',d.end_time,'last_status',d.status,'last_error_code',case when d.status='failed' then 'CRON_EXECUTION_FAILED' else null end) order by j.kind),'[]') into jobs
 from private.maintenance_cron_jobs j left join cron.job c on c.jobid=j.job_id and c.jobname=j.job_name and private.reservation_hash(to_jsonb(c.command))=j.command_hash and c.schedule=case when j.kind='RETENTION' then '17 * * * *' else '* * * * *' end and c.username='postgres' and c.database=current_database() and c.active=j.enabled
 left join lateral(select runid,start_time,end_time,status from cron.job_run_details where jobid=j.job_id order by runid desc limit 1)d on true;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.started_at desc),'[]') into runs from(select kind,started_at,finished_at,result from private.maintenance_runs order by started_at desc limit 12)x;
 return jsonb_build_object('mode','LOCAL_SYNTHETIC','as_of',at_time,'jobs',jobs,'runs',runs,'real_push_sent',0,'backlog',jsonb_build_object(
 'pending',(select count(*) from private.manual_publication_schedules where status='PENDING'),'held',(select count(*) from private.manual_publication_schedules where status='HELD'),
 'next_due',(select min(due_at) from private.manual_publication_schedules where status='PENDING'),
 'oldest_pending',(select min(due_at) from private.manual_publication_schedules where status='PENDING' and due_at<=at_time),
 'corrections_due',(select count(*) from private.issues where publication_state='CORRECTION_PENDING' and correction_pending_since<=at_time-interval '24 hours'),
 'raw_expired',(select count(*) from private.installation_qa_views where accepted_at<=at_time-interval '30 days'),
 'oldest_expired_raw',(select min(accepted_at) from private.installation_qa_views where accepted_at<=at_time-interval '30 days')));
end$function$

defs.private.catalog_sector_selectable(p_sect:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.catalog_sector_selectable(p_sector uuid, p_catalog bigint, p_article_mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_article_mode='SYNTHETIC'
 and exists(select 1 from private.runtime_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='preview' and bootstrap_id is null and schema_version=1 and (select count(*) from private.runtime_identity)=1 and (select count(*) from judoju_control.environment_identity)=1 and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.environment_identity where singleton and product_id='judoju-news' and environment='dev' and organization_ref='qfzgicohgpuogehdyzfx' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh') and exists(select 1 from judoju_control.schema_artifacts where version='20261114000001' and project_ref='nxfpfvsdwbziowkxsxnh' and runtime_environment='preview' and source_sha256='5b3c2d38206dc3c43c51db287d14584b3aa72b1f54d5b2e368e252a5fcf90caa' and state='STAGED_DISABLED'))
 and exists(select 1 from private.catalog_head h join private.catalog_versions v on v.version=h.version and v.active
 join private.catalog_approvals a on a.version=h.version and a.state='APPROVED'
 join private.catalog_snapshots c on c.version=h.version
 join private.catalog_version_sectors m on m.version=h.version and m.sector_id=p_sector and m.active and m.catalog_kind='LEAF'
 join private.sectors s on s.id=m.sector_id and s.active and s.catalog_kind='LEAF' and s.catalog_version=h.version
 left join private.sectors parent on parent.id=s.parent_id
 where h.version=p_catalog and
 ((c.usage_scope='LOCAL_REFERENCE' and m.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and s.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and s.sample_kind is null
 and parent.active and parent.catalog_kind='PARENT' and parent.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED' and parent.catalog_version=h.version)
 or (c.usage_scope='LEGACY_FIXTURE' and m.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE' and s.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE' and s.sample_kind='SYNTHETIC')))
$function$
defs.public.m1_public_articles(p_sector uuid,:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m1_public_articles(p_sector uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_cursor timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 then raise exception 'INVALID_PAGE_SIZE';end if;
  return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)) from(
    select n.issue_id,n.version_id,n.title,n.summary,n.first_published_at,n.material_change_at,n.sample_kind,v.public_body->>'article_kind' article_kind,s.name sector_name
    from public.news_public n join private.issues i on i.id=n.issue_id join private.article_versions v on v.id=n.version_id
    left join private.sectors s on s.id=i.primary_sector_id and s.active
    where n.publication_state='PUBLISHED' and private.m1_current_evidence(n.issue_id)
      and (p_sector is null or exists(select 1 from private.impacts z where z.version_id=v.id and z.sector_id=p_sector))
      and (p_cursor is null or n.first_published_at<p_cursor)
    order by n.first_published_at desc,n.issue_id limit p_limit
  )t),'[]');
end$function$
defs.public.catalog_public_search_companies(p:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_public_search_companies(p_expected bigint, p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_last_rank integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_last_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_last_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare head bigint;words text[];q text;items jsonb:='[]';item jsonb;last_item jsonb;more boolean:=false;used_bytes integer:=0;
begin
 head:=private.catalog_require_reference_head(p_expected);words:=private.search_tokens(p_query);q:=private.search_normalize(p_query);
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 20 or not (num_nonnulls(p_last_rank,p_last_name,p_last_id)=0 or
 (num_nonnulls(p_last_rank,p_last_name,p_last_id)=3 and p_last_rank between 0 and 3 and length(p_last_name) between 1 and 200)) then raise exception 'INVALID_CURSOR_CONTEXT';end if;
 for item in
  with matched as(
   select c.*,private.search_normalize(c.name) collate "C" sort_name,
    case when private.search_normalize(c.name)=q then 0
     when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(c.direct_keywords)kw where private.search_normalize(coalesce(kw->>'raw',kw->>'value'))=q) then 1
     when private.search_contains_all(c.name,words) then 2 else 3 end sort_rank
   from private.catalog_source_companies c where c.active and c.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED'
    and exists(select 1 from private.catalog_memberships m where m.source_company_ref=c.id and private.search_membership_visible(m.id,head))
    and private.search_contains_all(concat_ws(' ',c.name,(select string_agg(coalesce(kw->>'raw',kw->>'value'),' ') from jsonb_array_elements(c.direct_keywords)kw)),words)
  ),page as(
   select m.* from matched m where p_last_rank is null or (m.sort_rank,m.sort_name collate "C",m.id)>(p_last_rank,p_last_name collate "C",p_last_id)
   order by m.sort_rank,m.sort_name collate "C",m.id limit p_limit+1
  ) select jsonb_build_object('source_company_ref',id,'name',name,'search_description',search_description,'metadata_kind',metadata_kind,'stock_identity_state',stock_identity_state,
    'stock_code',null,'price',null,'change_percent',null,'stock_url',null,'related_sectors',private.search_company_sectors(id,head,0,3),
    'has_more_sectors',jsonb_array_length(private.search_company_sectors(id,head,3,1))>0,'sort_rank',sort_rank,'sort_name',sort_name)
   from page order by sort_rank,sort_name collate "C",id
 loop
  -- Keep the complete E description, including multiline source values. A byte
  -- budget can shorten a page; it never truncates the stored/displayed text.
  if jsonb_array_length(items)>=p_limit or used_bytes+octet_length(item::text)>220000 then more:=true;exit;end if;
  used_bytes:=used_bytes+octet_length(item::text);items:=items||jsonb_build_array(item);last_item:=item;
 end loop;
 if more and last_item is null then raise exception 'PUBLIC_RESPONSE_LIMIT';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('catalog_version',head::text,'items',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-'sort_rank'-'sort_name' order by n),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(items)with ordinality x(value,n)),
  'next',case when not more then null else jsonb_build_object('last_rank',last_item->'sort_rank','last_name',last_item->'sort_name','last_id',last_item->'source_company_ref') end);
end$function$
defs.public.catalog_public_company(p_expected:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_public_company(p_expected bigint, p_company uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_as_of timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_last_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_last_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare head bigint;cutoff timestamptz;company record;items jsonb;last_item jsonb;
begin
 head:=private.catalog_require_reference_head(p_expected);cutoff:=coalesce(p_as_of,statement_timestamp());
 if p_company is null or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 20 or cutoff>statement_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds' or cutoff<'2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 or (p_last_time is null)<>(p_last_id is null) or p_last_time>cutoff then raise exception 'INVALID_CURSOR_CONTEXT';end if;
 select c.id,c.name,c.search_description,c.metadata_kind,c.stock_identity_state into company from private.catalog_source_companies c
 where c.id=p_company and c.active and c.metadata_kind='USER_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED'
  and exists(select 1 from private.catalog_memberships m where m.source_company_ref=c.id and private.search_membership_visible(m.id,head));
 if company.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('catalog_version',head::text,'state','NOT_FOUND');end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by page.first_published_at desc,page.issue_id),'[]') into items from(
  select n.issue_id,n.version_id,n.title,n.summary,n.first_published_at,n.material_change_at,n.sample_kind,v.public_body->>'article_kind' article_kind,s.id sector_id,s.name sector_name,
   coalesce(s.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE',false) legacy_sector,
   case when v.public_body->>'primary_company_ref'=p_company::text then 'PRIMARY' else 'MENTIONED' end company_role
  from public.news_public n join private.issues i on i.id=n.issue_id and i.current_version_id=n.version_id
  join private.article_versions v on v.id=n.version_id left join private.sectors s on s.id=i.primary_sector_id and s.active
  where n.publication_state='PUBLISHED' and v.public_body->>'_contract'='M1' and jsonb_typeof(v.public_body->'company_refs')='array'
   and v.public_body->'company_refs' ? p_company::text
   and not exists(select 1 from private.issue_aliases a where a.alias_id=n.issue_id) and private.m1_current_evidence(n.issue_id)
   and n.first_published_at<=cutoff and v.created_at<=cutoff
   and (p_last_time is null or n.first_published_at<p_last_time or n.first_published_at=p_last_time and n.issue_id>p_last_id)
  order by n.first_published_at desc,n.issue_id limit p_limit+1)page;
 if jsonb_array_length(items)>p_limit then items:=items-p_limit;last_item:=items->(p_limit-1);end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('catalog_version',head::text,'state','AVAILABLE','as_of',cutoff,
  'company',jsonb_build_object('source_company_ref',company.id,'name',company.name,'search_description',company.search_description,'metadata_kind',company.metadata_kind,
   'stock_identity_state',company.stock_identity_state,'stock_code',null,'price',null,'change_percent',null,'stock_url',null,
   'related_sectors',private.search_company_sectors(company.id,head,0,20),'has_more_sectors',jsonb_array_length(private.search_company_sectors(company.id,head,20,1))>0),
  'items',items,'next',case when last_item is null then null else jsonb_build_object('last_time',last_item->'first_published_at','last_id',last_item->'issue_id') end);
end$function$
defs.public.catalog_public_search_news(p_expe:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.catalog_public_search_news(p_expected bigint, p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_as_of timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_last_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_last_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare head bigint;words text[];cutoff timestamptz;items jsonb;last_item jsonb;
begin
 head:=private.catalog_require_reference_head(p_expected);words:=private.search_tokens(p_query);cutoff:=coalesce(p_as_of,statement_timestamp());
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 20 or cutoff>statement_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds' or cutoff<'2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
 or (p_last_time is null)<>(p_last_id is null) or p_last_time>cutoff then raise exception 'INVALID_CURSOR_CONTEXT';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by page.first_published_at desc,page.issue_id),'[]') into items from(
  select n.issue_id,n.version_id,n.title,n.summary,n.first_published_at,n.material_change_at,n.sample_kind,v.public_body->>'article_kind' article_kind,s.id sector_id,s.name sector_name,
   coalesce(s.metadata_kind='SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE',false) legacy_sector
  from public.news_public n join private.issues i on i.id=n.issue_id and i.current_version_id=n.version_id
  join private.article_versions v on v.id=n.version_id left join private.sectors s on s.id=i.primary_sector_id and s.active
  where n.publication_state='PUBLISHED' and n.sample_kind='SYNTHETIC' and i.sample_kind='SYNTHETIC' and v.public_body->>'_contract'='M1'
   and not exists(select 1 from private.issue_aliases a where a.alias_id=n.issue_id) and private.m1_current_evidence(n.issue_id)
   and n.first_published_at<=cutoff and v.created_at<=cutoff
   and (p_last_time is null or n.first_published_at<p_last_time or n.first_published_at=p_last_time and n.issue_id>p_last_id)
   and private.search_contains_all(concat_ws(' ',n.title,n.summary,v.public_body->>'issue_analysis',
    (select string_agg(value,' ') from jsonb_array_elements_text(v.public_body->'key_issues')),
    (select string_agg(coalesce(kw->>'raw',kw->>'value'),' ') from private.catalog_sector_data d cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(d.keywords)kw
     where private.catalog_sector_selectable(d.sector_id,head,'SYNTHETIC') and (d.sector_id=i.primary_sector_id or exists(select 1 from private.impacts z where z.version_id=v.id and z.sector_id=d.sector_id)))),words)
  order by n.first_published_at desc,n.issue_id limit p_limit+1)page;
 if jsonb_array_length(items)>p_limit then items:=items-p_limit;last_item:=items->(p_limit-1);end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('catalog_version',head::text,'as_of',cutoff,'items',items,'next',case when last_item is null then null else jsonb_build_object('last_time',last_item->'first_published_at','last_id',last_item->'issue_id') end);
end$function$
defs.public.m0_publish(p_issue uuid, p_expect:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m0_publish(p_issue uuid, p_expected_revision bigint, p_title text, p_summary text, p_body jsonb, p_profile text, p_policy bigint, p_catalog bigint, p_effect_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin perform private.assert_editor();if private.caller_role()='authenticated' then raise exception 'M1_EDITOR_RPC_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501';end if;
return private.m0_publish_legacy(p_issue,p_expected_revision,p_title,p_summary,p_body,p_profile,p_policy,p_catalog,p_effect_key);end$function$
